Only this button temporarily stores the scenario in this browser tab. Review and edit the notes before submitting. Nothing is sent to the inquiry service by calculating.
Crane cost per project = fixed project cost + daily rental × rental days + crew × full-scope hours × person-hour cost.
Pole-lifter recurring cost per project = fixed project cost + crew × full-scope hours × person-hour cost + other project variable cost.
Annual net saving = (crane project cost − pole-lifter project cost) × projects per year − additional annual fixed cost.
Annual poles = poles per project × projects per year. Net saving per pole = annual net saving ÷ annual poles.
When net saving is positive and an investment is entered: break-even poles = investment ÷ net saving per pole (rounded up); payback months = investment ÷ annual net saving × twelve.

Annual fixed cost is allocated once. Initial investment is used only in payback. No resale value, financing, discount rate, tax difference, downtime or future cost change is included. Use comparable costs and the same currency throughout; the tool performs no exchange-rate conversion.
Zero project volume produces no annual result. A zero or negative saving produces no payback. A positive result still depends on the entered scope, volume and cost assumptions remaining valid.

Portable Light Pole Lifter Questions | volvet
Answers grounded in the current specification sheet, with project-specific questions kept open for review.
What pole height and load are listed?
The source sheet lists a 12 m light-pole class and 300 kg rated load. The complete assembly, attachments, flange, anchor bolts, foundation and site still need project review.
Does a matching height mean the equipment fits?
No. Send the assembled weight and drawings, including the base and foundation. A single matching dimension cannot establish suitability.
Is M24 included in the standard set?
M24 appears in the compatibility table. The standard included bolt list is M16, M18, M20 and M22, four sets per size; M24 is not listed as supplied by default.
What are the module weights and power supply?
The sheet lists a 45 kg hydraulic module and a 40 kg electrical cabinet, 85 kg total, with a 24 V rechargeable battery. Transport and handling need to account for both modules.
Is the lifting time a measured installation duration?

No. The manufacturer-reported 20 s figure does not describe the whole installation work package. The reported >50 lifts per full charge and >3000 usage count also remain source-sheet statements, with field validation pending.
Can I lift a complete solar lighting assembly?
The actual pole, panel, bracket, battery and other attachments need a configuration review. This website does not present a complete solar assembly as an already validated standard configuration.
Can the equipment replace a crane on my project?

That depends on the actual load, connections, foundation, site and assessed work method. Compare the same work scope and keep a crane or other assessed alternative open where suitability is unresolved.
How do I obtain a project quotation?

Submit the destination, contact details, project scope and available pole drawings. Unknown dimensions can be left open. Commercial arrangements are discussed privately after the configuration requirements are understood.
Can I estimate savings without a public selling price?

The calculator compares your own recurring project costs. An optional investment amount from your own records can produce conditional payback; no supplier price, country default rate or saving guarantee is supplied.
Are manuals, certificates and warranty terms available here?

Only the source-derived specification summary and information worksheet are currently downloadable. Reviewed operating instructions, compliance documents, delivery arrangements and warranty need confirmation for the actual supply and destination.
What does the inquiry receipt confirm?

It confirms that the request was saved in the private inbox. It does not confirm suitability, an order or delivery of an email notification. Direct email and phone channels remain pending configuration.
Where can I find operating instructions?
The online planning guides are not field procedures. Request reviewed instructions for the equipment and project; unresolved source wording is not expanded into anchoring or lifting steps.

This notice describes the information collected by the project inquiry service and how it is handled.

The inquiry form collects your name, an email address or phone number, and your country or delivery destination. Company, application, quantity, pole dimensions, foundation notes, project notes and an attachment are optional. Provide only what is useful for the request; avoid unrelated personal or confidential information.

The information is used to understand your request, review a project configuration, respond through the contact channel you provide and keep a record of the correspondence. Distributor, support and privacy requests use the same inquiry service with the selected purpose recorded.

An optional PDF, JPG or PNG of up to 5 MB can be submitted with the form. Attachments are held with the inquiry in the private inbox. They are not published on product pages or exposed through public download links. Avoid sending documents you are not authorised to share.

Requests are stored in a private inquiry database. The inbox, record details, attachments and export functions require a private operator access key. An on-page receipt confirms that the request was recorded; it does not mean an email notification was sent. External email notification and direct business contact channels are not yet configured.

The core procurement pages use local site assets and do not include an advertising or third-party analytics integration. The inquiry record can include the page, language and limited campaign labels used to reach the form. Personal form content is not sent as an analytics event. Operational protection uses a temporary request-rate counter; it is not added to the inquiry record.

Calculator inputs are processed in the page. Calculating alone does not send them to the inquiry service or store a scenario. If you choose to carry a scenario into an inquiry, its notes are held temporarily in this browser tab, accepted for up to thirty minutes and removed from that storage when the quote form reads them. Review or edit the notes before submission. Only a submitted inquiry stores those notes with the request; financial values are not included in the calculator analytics event.

The operator should retain project correspondence only while it is needed for the request and related business records. A production retention schedule and corporate contact identity still need to be confirmed before public deployment. To ask about access, correction or removal of an inquiry, choose “Privacy request” on the contact form and include its receipt reference, without adding unnecessary sensitive documents.
